description: St Regis Drug Bust Response.MP4Last week’s major drug seizure in St. Regis should command the attention of every Montanan. More than 28 pounds of illegal drugs — including fentanyl, methamphetamine, and cocaine — were intercepted on one of Montana’s highways. The operation resulted in 51 arrests, including 41 individuals believed to be in the country illegally.
